d: Long, flowing pale pink hair with straight-cut bangs and a high side-ponytail is paired with large, wide-set ruby red eyes and a youthful, adolescent facial expression. A petite build is dressed in a dark navy sailor-style uniform featuring a white collar with red trim, a large red bow at the chest, and a white sailor cap with a red ribbon. Attached to the body are heavy, dark grey mechanical naval artillery riggings with dual gun barrels.
